title: Anthropic Sets Fall IPO, Eyeing Trillions
excerpt: Morgan Stanley, Goldman, and JPMorgan are all lined up for the deal, but the public isn’t buying it…yet.
content_html:
Mitchell Duran

Tue, August 11, 2026 at 11:50 AM PDT 2 min read

BREAKING NEWS

Our analysts just identified a stock with the potential to be the next Nvidia. Tell us how you invest and we'll show you why it's our #1 pick. Tap here.

Anthropic set its target IPO window late Monday evening, as early as September or October 2026.

If all goes to plan, with Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan running the book, it will be the most valuable public AI company in the world. Post-money valuation after the latest Series H sits around $965 billion.

Given the momentum behind the SpaceX listing, analysts are speculating Anthropic's market cap could reach into the trillions. Annual recurring revenue runs $47 billion to $80 billion per Saastr.ai against SpaceX's $31 billion, so anything is possible.

OpenAI has yet to comment, though it did spend the week shipping GPT-5.6-Cyber and a ChatGPT desktop app for Linux. Oh, and COO Brad Lightcap announced he is leaving after roughly 4 years to "start something new."

The Wall Street Journal reported August 10 that Anthropic was meeting with investors to shore up confidence and address a growing public backlash against AI. Whether that means enticing retail buyers or maintaining the altruistic vibe after some Claude models have reportedly gone a bit rogue is uncertain. Pew Research found in mid-June that 16% of Americans expect AI to help society over the next 20 years, while 40% expect harm.

One stock. Nvidia-level potential. 30M+ investors trust Moby to find it first. Get the pick. Tap here.

The public, at least per Anthropic's books, is not much of a concern yet. Roughly 80% of revenue comes from enterprises, per a February Fortune report citing CEO Dario Amodei, with Claude Code at about $8 billion annualized by May.

Investor anxiety looks more likely to stem from the Chinese open-weight problem, where cheaper inference has pushed businesses toward models costing a fraction of Anthropic's top-tier intelligence. Should that trend hold, the bullish ARR could top out and dwindle, leaving new and locked-up investors holding the bag.

That is not going away. Meta, Nvidia, and Palantir all keep backing open-weight models in the name of "AI sovereignty," driving the price of inference toward zero.

Anthropic 周一晚间设定了其目标 IPO 窗口，最早是在 2026 年 9 月或 10 月。

如果一切按计划进行，由摩根士丹利、高盛和摩根大通负责运营，它将成为世界上最有价值的公共人工智能公司。 最新 H 轮融资后估值约为 9650 亿美元。

鉴于 SpaceX 上市背后的势头，分析师猜测 Anthropic 的市值可能会达到数万亿美元。 Saastr.ai 的年度经常性收入为 470 亿至 800 亿美元，而 SpaceX 为 310 亿美元，所以一切皆有可能。

OpenAI 尚未发表评论，尽管它确实花了一周时间发布了 GPT-5.6-Cyber​​ 和适用于 Linux 的 ChatGPT 桌面应用程序。 哦，首席运营官布拉德·莱特卡普 (Brad Lightcap) 宣布，他将在任职大约 4 年后离开，“开始新的事物”。

《华尔街日报》8 月 10 日报道称，Anthropic 正在与投资者会面，以提振信心并解决公众对人工智能日益强烈的抵制情绪。 这是否意味着吸引零售买家，或者在据报道一些克劳德模特变得有点无赖之后保持无私的氛围尚不确定。 皮尤研究中心 (Pew Research) 6 月中旬发现，16% 的美国人预计人工智能将在未来 20 年帮助社会，而 40% 的人预计人工智能会带来伤害。

一只股票。 Nvidia 级别的潜力。 超过 3000 万投资者相信 Moby 能够首先找到它。 得到选秀权。 点击此处。

至少根据 Anthropic 的书，公众还没有太担心。 根据《财富》杂志 2 月份的报告，首席执行官 Dario Amodei 援引 Claude Code 的数据，大约 80% 的收入来自企业，截至 5 月份，Claude Code 的年化收入约为 80 亿美元。

投资者的焦虑似乎更有可能源于中国的开放权重问题，其中更便宜的推理促使企业转向成本仅为 Anthropic 顶级情报一小部分的模型。 如果这种趋势持续下去，看涨的 ARR 可能会触顶并下降，让新的和锁定的投资者承担责任。

那不会消失。 Meta、Nvidia 和 Palantir 都以“人工智能主权”的名义继续支持开放权重模型，将推理成本推向零。
